Name: (CP) - Raining Things
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[size=6][center][b][u][color=#00ffff]The Rainer[/color][/u][/b][/center][/size]
[size=3]With this mod you will be able to change the raindrops for other objects such as daggers, bones, slimes, among others that I will add later.
They are only visual effects, nothing will harm you. It does not affect crops or other game elements.[/size]
[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]This mod may reduce the performance of your game if you have a less powerful device.[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]There is also an option to remove raindrops, which gives a small increase in performance in low-end devices..[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Without much more to add, enjoy!

[/b][/size][/color]

Downloads.Description: Unzip and move the folder to the game mods folder.
